app: Dark Ambient Prompt Generator + Ambient Video Studio

urlParams.title: audio title; the generator picks everything from it (e.g. ?title=Aurora%20%C2%B7%20Weightless%20Ambient%20for%20Sleep)

promptOrder: Unexpected detail: {twist}.  (omitted when twist is empty)
Foreground: {foreground}, sparse and understated.  (omitted when framing.fg === false)

constants.ORIGINAL: an original, nameless design unlike any real landmark
constants.INTEGRATE: It shares the scene's haze, light and dust and fades with distance like everything else, never looking pasted in.
constants.GLOW: A faint cold glow in the haze behind it gently separates its silhouette.
constants.DESERTED: Clean, calm ground with little debris. No people, animals, vehicles, lights, text or watermark.
constants.TITLE_SPACE: Keep one calm, empty area of sky or haze for a title.

photo.label: Fotorealistis
photo.text: A real photograph, not a painting or CGI: full-frame camera on a tripod, long exposure, deep focus, true monumental scale with no miniature look, natural light, weathered real materials, subtle film grain, low contrast, muted tones, no HDR. Quiet and meditative, a background for a long ambient music video.

matte.label: Matte Painting
matte.text: A cinematic, atmospheric matte painting: soft diffused light, deep focus, true monumental scale, low contrast, muted tones. Quiet and meditative, a background for a long ambient music video.

framings.label: Simetris + pantulan
framings.text: Centered and symmetrical, head-on at eye level, 35mm; mirrored in still water or ice below, horizon at mid-frame.

framings.label: Dibingkai reruntuhan
framings.text: Seen through a large broken archway or shattered window in the dark foreground, which frames it on all sides; 28mm.

framings.label: Dari dalam ke luar
framings.text: Shot from deep inside a ruin looking out; dark collapsed walls form the frame edges, the landscape and the structure glow faintly beyond; 24mm.

framings.label: Drone dari atas
framings.text: High aerial view looking steeply down; the structure in the lower part of the frame, vast ground patterns fading into haze above; 35mm.

framings.label: Telefoto berlapis
framings.text: Long telephoto, 200mm, compressing distance; the structure and fainter layers of ruins behind it stacked like paper cut-outs, each paler in the haze.

framings.label: Low angle menjulang
framings.text: Extreme low angle from near its base, 16mm ultra-wide; it towers out of the top of the frame, lines converging into the haze.

framings.label: Muncul sebagian
framings.text: Only part of it enters from the left edge, huge and cropped, dissolving into fog; the right two-thirds empty; 50mm.

framings.label: Horizon tinggi
framings.text: High horizon near the top; textured ground fills most of the frame, the structure small but sharp near the top-left; 24mm.

framings.label: Diagonal menjauh
framings.text: Its repeated forms run diagonally from the near-left corner into the far right, shrinking and fading; 28mm, slightly elevated.

framings.label: Kecil di kiri
framings.text: Placed small but readable in the far left third, facing a huge empty space to the right; slightly elevated, 35mm.

framings.label: Panorama sinematik
framings.text: Wide cinematic panorama, 2.39:1 feeling inside the frame, the structure on the right third, a long band of haze across the middle; 40mm anamorphic look.

framings.label: Siluet berlatar terang
framings.text: Backlit: a pale bright patch of haze directly behind it turns it into a near-black silhouette with soft edges; 50mm.

framings.label: Dari kejauhan, lapisan bukit
framings.text: Seen from a ridge far away, 85mm; several receding ridges of terrain in front of it, each paler, the structure on the last visible layer.

framings.label: Close-up detail + skala
framings.text: Close to one corner of the structure, 24mm, its weathered surface filling one side of the frame while the rest of it rises away into the haze, showing its immense scale.

framings.label: Dari bawah permukaan
framings.text: Viewed from a low hollow or trench, the ground edges framing the bottom of the image, the structure rising on the horizon beyond; 28mm.

framings.label: Off-center tinggi
framings.text: The structure placed high in the right third, a long empty slope or plain leading up to it from the bottom-left; 35mm.

a vast circular opening pierces its center
a colossal fallen statue head lies half-buried near its base
its upper part is intact while its base has crumbled away
it is half swallowed by the ground, only the upper levels visible
a long bridge leads from it to nowhere, broken off in the haze
it is impossibly tall and thin, vanishing into the sky
giant chains hang from it into the haze below
a perfectly round pool of still water lies before it
rows of identical smaller copies of it stand in the far distance
it is wrapped in vast tattered sheets of fabric moving slightly
part of it has been turned upside down and rests on its own roof
emptiness: layers of haze receding into nothing
a horizon lost entirely in fog

revisions.label: Terlihat miniatur
revisions.text: Remove the miniature / tilt-shift look: use deep focus so the foreground and background are both sharp, and make the structure feel truly monumental and real-world sized.

revisions.label: Terlihat tempelan
revisions.text: Integrate the structure into the scene: apply the same haze, light direction and color grading to it, soften its contrast with distance, and cover it with the same dust or sediment as the ground.

revisions.label: Subjek terlalu kecil
revisions.text: Make the main structure noticeably larger and closer, about a third of the frame height, while keeping the empty space around it.

revisions.label: Subjek terlalu besar
revisions.text: Move the camera further back so the structure becomes smaller and more distant, with more empty space and haze around it.

revisions.label: Terlalu ramai
revisions.text: Simplify the image: remove most of the debris, branches and small objects, keep the ground calm and clean, and keep only the main structure and the atmosphere.

revisions.label: Terlalu terang
revisions.text: Make the whole image darker and moodier: lower the exposure, deepen the shadows, and keep only a faint, soft light.

revisions.label: Terlalu gelap
revisions.text: Lift the shadows slightly so the structure and its details are readable, while keeping the dark, quiet mood.

revisions.label: Warna terlalu kuat
revisions.text: Desaturate the colors and lower the contrast for a muted, calm, filmic look.

revisions.label: Kabut kurang
revisions.text: Add more layered atmospheric haze between the camera and the structure, so the background fades softly.

revisions.label: Terlalu berkabut
revisions.text: Reduce the haze slightly so the structure's shape and weathered details are clearer, keeping a soft atmosphere.

revisions.label: Mirip bangunan terkenal
revisions.text: Redesign the structure so it no longer resembles any real or famous landmark: give it an original, unique architecture while keeping the same style and mood.

revisions.label: Kurang nyata
revisions.text: Make it look like a real photograph: natural light, real weathered materials, subtle film grain and lens imperfections, no painterly or CGI look.

revisions.label: Ada objek aneh
revisions.text: Remove any people, animals, vehicles, text, doors, lights or other out-of-place objects from the scene.

revisions.label: Ruang judul kurang
revisions.text: Keep a larger calm, empty area of sky or haze, free of details, where a title can be placed.
